script_text: Gemini, this week Mercury retrograde in your 3rd House is about to flip your entire communication world upside down. Early week, Mercury squares Neptune on Monday and Tuesday, creating foggy conversations and misread emails — avoid signing contracts before Wednesday. Your best early days are Tuesday and Wednesday when the Moon sextiles your ruling planet Mercury, clearing the mental static. The turning point arrives Thursday when Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance and creative passion like a match to dry kindling. Late week, Friday through Sunday, Venus trines your Sun, making Saturday your power day for love — a surprise connection or rekindled spark is written in the stars. Career-wise, Mars in your 10th House all week pushes you toward bold professional moves, especially Sunday when opportunities land in your lap. Wednesday is your power day because the Moon sextile Mercury sharpens your legendary wit and clarity. Worst day is Monday due to that Mercury-Neptune square clouding your judgment. This week, Gemini, write down every idea that comes to you — your air element is electrified and your Mercury-ruled mind is a goldmine. Follow for daily updates.
